free_tier.stated: New accounts include $300 in free credits and no payment details are required to sign up. The documentation states 'Aiven offers a free trial for 30 days with credits you can use to explore the Aiven Platform. You don't need a credit card to sign up.' The amount and the duration are on two different pages.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the offer is a spending balance, not a stored object

retention.stated: the trial runs 30 days; the free service tier is separate and unlimited

egress.terms: not stated on the pages read

interface_detail: the Aiven console, the Aiven CLI and per-service connection URIs; no general-purpose VM
tooling: the Aiven CLI, the Terraform provider, and each service's native client
chaining: the credit pays for managed PostgreSQL, Kafka, Valkey and the rest at list price; it does not buy a machine that runs arbitrary software

limits.value: USD 300 of credit over a 30-day trial

limits_note: the amount is published on the developer-tier page and the 30 days on the service-pricing documentation; the /free-trial/ path returns 404

identity_cost.detail: no payment details are required to sign up; Google, Microsoft, GitHub or email; the console is JavaScript-only so the form fields were not observed live

reliability_note: the free service tier continues indefinitely and is separate from the trial credit, so a service can outlive the balance on the Free plan
confidence_note: two first-party Aiven pages were read on 2026-10-23; the trial URL carried by the search index is dead, so the amount and the duration are each sourced from the page that still carries them

evidence.proved: quoted: 'New accounts include $300 in free credits and no payment details are required to sign up.'
quoted: 'Aiven offers a free trial for 30 days with credits you can use to explore the Aiven Platform. You don't need a credit card to sign up.'

binding_note: USD 300 over 30 days is 41.7 cents an hour, and the balance is the only thing that ends the trial
notes: The credit buys managed services only. The smallest paid plans are Developer at $5 a month (1 CPU, 1 GiB, 8 GB) and Hobbyist at $12 a month or $0.02 an hour (1 CPU, 1 GiB, 8 GB). A general-purpose process cannot be hosted here.
